analysis.comparison: Match solver policy, seeds and medium to prior agent validation. Search efficiency comparisons require common roots and equal evaluation counts.
analysis.interpretation: MG1655 expression-knockout model evidence; does not physically shorten the chromosome or establish laboratory viability.

authorization.credential_transfer: Pending approval: W&B tracking key only over encrypted SSH; owner-only permissions; excluded from backups.

cost_proposal.estimate_basis: Scaled previous approximately 300-cell validation to 720 cells, same nine-cell concurrency; genotype runtime is uncertain.

execution.deadlines: Set once from actual launch time; reserve last hour for preservation. Never reset on retry.
execution.shared_worker: Leave all preexisting shared compute unchanged.

preservation.checkpoint: Closed cells only; full S3 GET SHA256 plus committed W&B artifact download verification; halt on backup failure.
preservation.cleanup: Stop by hard deadline. Preserve disk on verification failure; terminate only dedicated worker and delete volume after independent final member audit.
preservation.credentials: Screen all locally configured historical secrets before metadata publication. Transfer only W&B tracking credential; remote scans all configured credentials. No source archives as data.
preservation.ledger: Update experiments.json and working migration ledger with exact immutable S3/W&B refs, source hashes, failures, statuses and costs.

remote_preflight_required: Verify exact restored input and source hashes
Build native extensions using pinned native runtime without modifying scientific source
Run exact-knockout audit on all 12 genotypes before dispatch
Run offline controller, solver and backup integrity checks
Verify bucket ownership, public-access blocks and W&B data round trips
Verify persistent hard shutdown timer, process identities and exclusive locks

scientific_conditions.interpretation: Longer model diagnostic, not laboratory viability or a calibrated predictive endpoint.

selection.rule: Nominate one final jointly feasible state per run using the frozen ordering; deduplicate exact genotypes. Report no improvement explicitly. Freeze the entire nomination list before any vEcoli results.

solver_policy: Apply the documented v2 numerical recovery consistently to all five genotypes. Retry GLP_UNBND once with fresh basis, presolve and ordinary simplex refinement, unchanged LP/objective/constraints/tolerances; accept only identical LP hash, GLP_OPT and finite KKT relative residuals <=1e-7. Latch validation failure against outer retries. Log every fallback and distinguish patch-assisted cells from unassisted trajectories. No candidate substitutions or additional repairs after results.

tracking.monitor: Use approved scheduled monitoring; notify only completion, new failures, actionable stalls or required user action.
